text:
Mina: Quick heads-up — customers hitting 403 when exporting audit logs to CSV from Console (JSON export works). Seen with two enterprise tenants.

Aditya: Can you paste the exact error? request ID?

Mina: Repro steps in Console -> Audit -> filter by team=acmecorp -> Export -> CSV. Error modal: "Export failed: permission denied (403)". No details in UI. Request ID: r-7f3c2.

Liz: I repro'd locally against staging. Same 403. UI call is POST /api/v1/audit/exports with body {format: "csv", filters: {...}}. If I change format to json it succeeds.

Samir: That smells like a backend permission check path difference. CSV export goes through the report-generator service which uses a service-account. JSON uses streaming endpoint with the user's token?

Mina: Exactly — hypothesis: CSV runs as the caller but with an extra validation that checks `audit_viewer` AND `export` scope. JSON export skipped that check.

Rebecca: From product POV customers expect parity CSV/JSON. Also need to ensure exported rows have the new schema fields: we've added kms_key_id, resource.owner, and event_version in the last migration. Are we validating those in exports?

audit-bot: Schema migration applied: audit_events.v3 with fields [event_type, actor, resource, timestamp, kms_key_id, resource_owner, event_version]. Migration note: kms_key_id nullable.

Aditya: Thanks. Two parallel actions: 1) fix permission gap so CSV uses service account with proper RBAC check or delegates correctly. 2) add validation to export pipeline to ensure all exported rows conform to v3 schema and redact PII fields when customer requests.

Liz: Quick log from report-generator for r-7f3c2:
```
ERROR audit.export: permission denied user=liz@redwood.com action=export.format=csv required=role.audit_exporter got=role.audit_viewer
stack: /app/exports/handler.go:142
```

Samir: That shows backend is checking role.audit_exporter. Why did role mapping change? We recently merged RBAC changes (PR #4382) that split `audit_viewer` vs `audit_exporter`. The Console previously assumed export privilege for `audit_viewer`.

Mina: We need to decide: revert RBAC split or update Console + docs to require `audit_exporter` for CSV. For enterprise tenants, that'd be a breaking change.

Rebecca: We shouldn't surprise customers. Can we do a compatibility shim: if user has `audit_viewer` + `can_export=true` in org settings, allow CSV for now, and schedule migration to new role in 30 days?

Aditya: Technical plan: add check in auth middleware that treats `audit_viewer` as allowed for export if org flag `legacy_audit_export` set. Also add a config flag in Dedicated/Private to flip. Deploy to staging to validate.

Mina: Also: exports must include `kms_key_id` for KMS-linked events. Product wants clear column header. Confirming: if kms_key_id is present but masked for customer (KMS is managed), should we show key id or redact?

Rebecca: For managed KMS, show `kms_key_id` but truncate to first 8 chars and mask rest. Add column `kms_key_redacted`? Prefer just `kms_key_id` masked. Document behaviour.

ops-oncall: Note about audit retention: when exporting large date ranges, pagination uses offset which killed performance. We should switch CSV export to cursor-based pagination (continuation token) to avoid repeated scans. Seen in support ticket #9821.

Samir: Good catch. Cursor tokens will also let us produce streaming CSV easily without loading the whole result set. Implementation notes: the export job should stream rows from DB using a cursor and pipe to CSV writer. Also ensure schema validation per-row: if event_version != v3 then map fields to v3 shape with default values.

Liz: QA checklist suggestion:
- attempt CSV & JSON exports as audit_viewer (legacy org)
- attempt as audit_viewer without legacy flag -> expect 403
- attempt as audit_exporter -> expect success
- verify kms_key_id column present and masked per policy
- export with large date range -> ensure continuation tokens & no timeouts
- validate CSV vs JSON row counts equal

Mina: Who wants to own the patch? Samir for backend + auth shim, Liz for Console client fix, Aditya for rollout/feature flag, Rebecca for docs + customer comms. I'll own QA and follow-up.

Aditya: I'll open a short-lived feature flag: `legacy_audit_export` default true for staging; plan to flip off for GA in 30 days and notify customers. Also add server-side audit event that records export attempts, including `export_format`, `filters`, `initiator_role`, and `export_status` so we can later validate customer-facing logs.

Mina: One more: export CSV must validate that no sensitive fields (like user_password_hash or raw_kms_material) ever make it to customer exports. Add a deny-list in export pipeline that strips these keys.

Samir: Will add denylist and mapping code. Code pointer: /services/report-generator/exports/mapper.go. I'll put a TODO to sanitize fields before CSV encoding.

Rebecca: I'll prepare a short customer note template explaining the role change and the temporary compatibility flag. Also ask support to proactively reach out to tenants with `audit_viewer` only who attempted exports in last 90 days.

Mina: Great. I'll create a postmortem-like doc for this permission UX gap and capture timeline + mitigation. Tagging @Aditya @Samir @Liz for follow-ups. :thumbsup:

audit-bot: Deploy queued: report-generator v1.12.3 -> staging (includes RBAC shim + cursor pagination).

Liz: Deploy on staging looks green, CSV export now succeeds for legacy orgs. Will start QA checklist now and report any anomalies.

Mina: Thanks — keep updates in this thread. If QA finds anything high-severity ping #incidents.

Aditya: Filed tasks: GH-4510 (auth-shim), GH-4511 (cursored-export), GH-4512 (schema-normalizer), GH-4513 (docs + comms). Comments in PRs will reference this thread id r-7f3c2.

Samir: I'll schedule a follow-up in 2 days to flip the staging flag off and run customer smoke tests.

Liz: QA notes (later): found one edgecase — events created before v3 had null resource_owner and our normalizer filled `resource_owner` with `unknown` which confuses CSV consumers. I'll open GH-4520 to allow empty string instead.

Mina: Noted. End of thread.
